filing.title: EuroMed plc Schedule CB cross-border exchange offer
filing.bodyText:
Schedule CB
Offeror: EuroMed plc
Target company is BioThera Inc.
This Schedule CB is filed for a cross-border exchange offer. Holders of BioThera Inc. ADSs will receive 0.75 EuroMed plc ordinary shares for each BioThera ADS tendered in the exchange offer. The offer will expire on August 3, 2026, unless extended. If elections exceed the available share cap, acceptances will be subject to proration. The offer is made in reliance on the Tier II cross-border exemption.

important_facts.exchange_ratio: 0.75 EuroMed plc ordinary shares for each BioThera ADS
